reconciliation_phase: Phase 5 - Independent Paper Execution & Regulatory Accounting Audit

lifecycle_stages: 5_paper_fill_simulation (0.03% slippage applied to fill price only)

fill_model_fidelity.tape_price_separation: Observed market prices are strictly segregated from simulated fill prices; market tape is never altered by simulated slippage
fill_model_fidelity.slippage_model: 1.0003 for BUY fills (+0.03%), 0.9997 for SELL fills (-0.03%)
fill_model_fidelity.partial_fills_handling: Supported via filled_qty attribute; remaining quantity maintained in OPEN state until timeout or cancellation
fill_model_fidelity.restart_recovery: Restores open positions from positions_memory table on system boot; 6 positions currently maintained in sandbox memory

option_premium_vs_spot_accounting.quarantine_rule: Options lacking valid contract strike/expiry syntax (e.g. raw 'BANKNIFTY' at 51,800.0) are quarantined as QUARANTINED / UNRESOLVED to prevent severe turnover distortion
option_premium_vs_spot_accounting.turnover_formula: Price * Qty (Contract Premium Turnover, NOT Spot Index Notional)
option_premium_vs_spot_accounting.statutory_charge_policy: Zero charges are invented for unverified or quarantined records; records without sufficient metadata fail closed as UNRESOLVED

qualification_gate_verdict.qualification_threshold: min 5 verified authentic closed trades and verified net PnL > 0
qualification_gate_verdict.reason: 100% of historical production data and exploratory simulation records are synthetic/simulated; zero verified authentic live-feed trades exist.
